stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G009】代词指代一致性、比较替代词（that/those of）与消除指代悬空；【G014】情态动词、确定性梯度与科学谨慎表达（Epistemic Hedging）。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP014】使用 respectively 与平行结构实现高密度信息配对，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 代词指代一致性、比较替代词（that/those of）与消除指代悬空
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 代词必须具有唯一、明确的先行词。学术写作中严禁出现可同时指向多个名词的歧义代词（ambiguous pronoun）或缺乏总结名词的裸奔 this。
rules: 当句中有两个同数名词时，不用裸 it/they/this，应改用 the former / the latter 或 This + 总结性范畴名词（this discrepancy, this constraint, these observations）。
比较结构中必须用 that of 替代前文单数/不可数名词，用 those of 替代前文复数可数名词，确保比较对象同范畴（The cost is low relative to that of the earlier procedure）。
examples: The pronoun makes the final sentence ambiguous.
The cost is low relative to that of the earlier procedure.
These findings differ from those reported in the earlier study.
We compare interviews and surveys; the former allow follow-up questions.
common_errors: 比较结构漏掉 that/those of，导致拿“误差”直接跟“基线模型”相比：*The error of our model is lower than the baseline（应为 lower than that of the baseline）。

grammar_instruction.name: 情态动词、确定性梯度与科学谨慎表达（Epistemic Hedging）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 科学写作要求结论的语气强度与实验/数据证据的完备度严格对齐。通过情态动词（may, might, can, could）、认知副词（arguably, apparently, plausibly, relatively, typically）及谨慎动词（suggest, indicate, point to, appear to）控制断言边界。
rules: 当存在未测混杂（unmeasured confounding）、小样本或仿真环境限制时，必须使用 may be attributable to / suggests that / supports a tentative conclusion。
禁止在经验研究中滥用 irrefutable, undeniable, inevitable, universal, conclusively prove；只有经核实的数学反例推翻全称命题时才可用 disprove / irrefutable。
examples: The observed discrepancy may be attributable to differences in measurement procedures.
A distributional forecast is arguably more informative when decisions depend on tail risk.
The verified counterexample provides irrefutable evidence that the universal mathematical claim is false.
common_errors: 在改写或总结时删去原句的 may / arguably / in this sample 等限定词，造成过度绝对化。

grammar_instruction.name: 语态的语篇决策：基于研究对象、旧信息前置与施事责任的主动/被动选择
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 破除“被动语态一定比主动语态更学术”的迷思。语态选择服务于：(1) 维持句间话题链连贯（把上句提到的受事对象作为本句被动主语，满足 Given-before-New），(2) 明确谁对设计决策或核验承担责任。
rules: 当描述标准化数据清洗、传感器部署或客观流程，且受事对象是段落主题时，选用被动语态（The records are arranged in chronological order before the time-series analysis）。
当阐述本文核心创新设计、范围限定决策或强调多名标注者独立操作时，选用主动语态（We confine the analysis to...; Two analysts analysed the data independently; The algorithm exploits the sparsity of the matrix）。
examples: Passive for topic continuity: The predictions are compared with ground-truth labels that were checked by two annotators.
Active for clear methodological agency: We reformulate the constrained problem as an equivalent optimization problem.
common_errors: 通篇机械使用被动语态导致语句冗长、施事责任模糊（如分不清是前人文献做的还是本文做的）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 使用 respectively 与平行结构实现高密度信息配对
expression_pattern_instruction.template: [Symbol/Group A] and [Symbol/Group B] denote/represent [Entity X] and [Entity Y], respectively.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 在不增加从句负担的前提下清晰交代多组符号或实验参数的一一对应关系。
examples: The symbols x and y denote temperature and demand, respectively.
The slope and intercept of f(x) = ax + b are a and b, respectively.
common_errors: 前后序列元素数量不匹配或顺序颠倒。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定
expression_pattern_instruction.template: Let [symbol] denote the observation at time t; we decompose the series into [components] and evaluate predictions over horizon H.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于机器学习与时间序列论文的 Problem Formulation 部分，清晰界定输入历史窗口、滞后项（lagged observations）与预测步长。
examples: Here, N denotes the number of observations, and a lag of one step links the current state to the preceding observation.
Time-series decomposition separates a series into components such as trend, seasonality and remainder.
common_errors: 未说明采样间隔（sampling interval）就直接声称某个 lag 代表固定物理时长。
